headline: Ratko Mladic, Bosnian-Serb general convicted of genocide, dies age 84
description: A key military architect of the 'Greater Serbia' project, Mladic was convicted in 2017 of 'genocide, crimes against humanity and war crimes' during the war in Bosnia and Herzegovina by judges at the International Criminal Tribunal for the former Yugoslavia. Imprisoned in The Hague, he died on August 27.

The Suez Canal: Birth and death of a colonial myth
description: 'Suez, a historic canal' (1/6). In 1869, the creation of a maritime route linking the Mediterranean Sea and the Red Sea, operated by the French and the British, captivated Europe. Initially a symbol of colonial oppression for the Egyptian people, the waterway became a tool of emancipation when President Nasser announced its nationalization 70 years ago, on July 26, 1956.

headline: 'We can't water a forest': Switzerland is testing a forestry method to protect against wildfires
description: 'Room for Hope' (2/6). While too many European forests have been turned into timber factories through monoculture and clear-cutting, the Swiss Confederation is testing an ancient technique that encourages cooler conditions and greater biodiversity.
